sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Kamal Dev Rai Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the proceedings of Complaint Case No.
2349 of 2018 under Sections 498A IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Friends Colony,
District Etawah, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Etawah and the summoning order dated 18.2.2019.

entities.text: court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Etawah
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that this court vide order dated 05.11.2019 had referred the matter to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court.
A settlement/agreement had been arrived at on 27.1.2021 between the parties.
A copy of the same is on record.
Perusal of the settlement/agreement thus reached reveals that the parties have amicably settled their dispute and further agreed to withdraw the cases between them.

The said fact has been mentioned in para 7 and Balak Ram @ Raju And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125567602/
1 8 of the settlement/agreement dated 27.1.2021.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Paragraph 7 and 8 of the said report reads as under:
"7.

In view of the Interim Settlement dated 04.03.2020, the following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:
a) That the parties have decided to live separately and in this regard they have filed a petition u/s 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act in Family Court, Etawah, which is registered as Case No. 416 of 2020.
The certified copy of aforesaid divorce petition is being annexed to this settlement for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.

b) That it has been agreed between the parties that Balak Ram @ Raju (applicant no.
1-husband) shall pay an amount of Rs. 19,00,000/- (Rs. Nineteen Lakh only) to the wife which shall include permanent alimony and Stridhan of the wife.

Out of the aforesaid amount today i.e. 27.01.2021, the applicant has hand over a demand drafts bearing no. 703130 dated 07.01.2021 drawn on State Bank of India for Rs.
9,50,000/- (Nine Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) issued in the name of Radha D/o Hajoori Lal to the O.P. No. 2-wife and she has acknowledged the receipt of the same.

c) That it has been agreed between the parties that the remaining amount i,e. Rs.
9,50,000/- (Nine Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) will be given by Balak Ram @ Raju (applicant no. 1-husband) to the wife Smt. Radha @Preeti (O.P. No. 2-wife) at the time of final judgment in aforesaid divorce petition before the Family Court, Etawah d) That it has been agreed between the parties that the cases filed by them against each other regarding present matrimonial dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by taking appropriate steps before the Court/authority concerned.

e) That it has also been agreed between the parties that they will not file any case/
complaint against each other regarding the present matrimonial dispute in future also.
f) That it has been agreed between the parties that they shall not violate the terms and conditions of this settlement-agreement, otherwise the aggrieved party will be free to take legal recourse.

8.-By signing this Agreement the Parties hereto state that the Applicant U/S 482 No. 39393 of 2019 and all disputes and differences in this regard have been amicably settled by the Parties hereto through the process of Conciliation/Mediation."

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and taking into account the settlement/agreement arrived at between the parties on 27.1.2021 before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court, the proceedings in the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
In view of the above, the present application is allowed.
